# TPC-Havoc Q15_v7

```{tags} reference, query-template, tpchavoc
```

> [TPC-Havoc](../../tpc-havoc.md) benchmark · [all TPC-Havoc queries](index.md)

## Representative SQL

Rendered for **DataFusion** with default parameters.

```sql
WITH revenue_with_filter AS (SELECT l_suppkey AS supplier_no, SUM(l_extendedprice * (1 - l_discount)) FILTER(WHERE l_shipdate >= CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) AND l_shipdate < CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH') AS total_revenue FROM lineitem WHERE l_shipdate >= CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) AND l_shipdate < CAST('1996-01-01' AS DATE) + INTERVAL '3 MONTH' GROUP BY l_suppkey) SELECT s.s_suppkey, s.s_name, s.s_address, s.s_phone, r.total_revenue FROM supplier AS s, revenue_with_filter AS r WHERE s.s_suppkey = r.supplier_no AND r.total_revenue = (SELECT MAX(total_revenue) FROM revenue_with_filter) ORDER BY s.s_suppkey
```
